data.body: Pending design escalation — unamicable-exuberant-chupacabra (9c90-9015-78ea-4d2c): proven runtime RCA shows the exact zero-pending gate scans all 4,371 ticket directories and cannot satisfy the authoritative 20 ms budget with any tested stateless exact reducer (best measured about 69.5 ms; current path 437–504 ms). Recommended choice: move the exact scan off the caller into a detached, coalesced gate/drain child, with bounded-spawn and lock-coalescing semantics. Alternatives: persistent derived HEAD-keyed queue index with atomicity/invalidation/rebuild policy; accept about 70 ms and raise the budget; or disable/scope opportunistic drain. No Phase 2 work or implementation exists; resume at plan/file-impact + held-out RED oracle after user decision.
